CustomField.label: Is Known Contact
CustomField.description:
★R8 True when Contact__c is populated — "we have matched this person to a Contact". It exists because the lookup itself is only legible to a user who has Read on Contact, and that grant is the org's to make; this checkbox carries the part of the answer that needs no such permission, so a report can count how many of an event's guests are already known to the org without exposing which Contacts they are.
Read it as evidence, not as a fact about the world: false means nothing has linked them, which covers both "not a Contact" and "nobody has run the reconciliation yet".
